card.name: Units of measure after an amount
card.fires_on: Mainly the unit word (grams, mg, mL) right after a number in a dose or concentration, as in 'per 20 grams of dextrose'. Weaker hits on a few unrelated words such as 'when' or 'alarm'.

modes.label: Unit after a number
modes.description: A measure like grams, mg or mL directly after a quantity, followed by 'of' or a substance.
modes.example: containing 10 units of crystalline insulin per 20<< grams>> of dextrose administered intravenously

modes.label: Scattered non-medical words
modes.description: Occasional hits on ordinary linking or noun words in general web text.
modes.example: special green ink dots that glow<< when>> exposed to ultraviolet light
